context: Request: M&A deals where the firm actually invoked or litigated specific performance, with the papers. Rubric: 1018-00008 (Penterra/Veridian: Veridian's October 2024 demand to compel closing), proof documents (the draft counterclaim, and matter-status-memo-deal-terminated.docx as corroboration of the threatened claim), plus precision. 1022-00002 (Northgate/Ridgeline APA, papers labelled internal matter 1018-00009, with a reservation of a specific-performance remedy) is outside the set.

divergence: All fail, two ways. All three runs reached the lead matter through store-wide scans and read its demand analysis, risk memos and draft pleadings. T0 and T1 listed every file of that matter but never opened its status memo, which a proof criterion requires (first error at the reading stage that chose that matter's documents; no review named the memo). T2 read the memo during its snippet stage and passed that criterion, but it, like T1, wrote a second deal where counsel only reserved the remedy in letters as qualifying (precision fails); T0 kept that deal out. No review questioned the second deal; check reviews repeatedly said not to change the qualifying set. T1 reopened its check stage eight times, receiving the reopen-count notes, with wording edits only. Agent-declared new stages (scan aggregation, store-wide sweep) mapped to the scan stage.
